Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. Follow so you don't miss the results! 👇 Keywords: Hindi: रागी की रोटी, ब्लड शुगर कंट्रोल, डायबिटीज डाइट, ग्लूकोज स्पाइक, हेल्दी लाइफस्टाइल, न्यूट्रिशन हैक्स। English: Ragi Roti, Blood Sugar Control, Diabetes Diet, Glucose Spike, Healthy Alternatives, CGM Experiment, Nutrition Myths. #RagiRoti #GlucoseSpike #DiabetesReversal #CGMExperiment #NutritionMyths

#creatorsearchinsights #fypシ゚viral__  Sejarah Ragi  Simak penjelasan lengkap nya dibawah: Sejarah Ragi: Dari Kuno ke Modern 1. Zaman Kuno – Dipake tanpa tau namanya   - 7000–6000 SM: Mesopotamia & Mesir Kuno bikin bir & roti pake ragi liar dari udara. - 2000 SM: Cina udah fermentasi arak beras & kecap pake ragi herbal. - Nusantara: Tape & brem muncul dari teknik fermentasi Cina-India. Ragi dibikin dari beras + rempah. 2.  Tokoh Penemu/Perintis Ragi 1. Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (1680): Pertama liat sel ragi pake mikroskop. Dia nyebut "animalcules" tapi belum tau fungsinya.   2. Louis Pasteur (1857): Buktiin fermentasi itu kerja mikroorganisme hidup. Dia jelasin peran Saccharomyces cerevisiae → bapak mikrobiologi.   3. Theodor Schwann (1837): Ahli fisiologi Jerman yang nyebut ragi sebagai tumbuhan hidup & penyebab fermentasi alkohol. Dia salah satu pencetus "teori sel". Sebelum Pasteur, Schwann udah bilang fermentasi = proses biologis, bukan kimia biasa. 3. Perkembangan Kuno → Modern Kuno:   - Ragi liar, hasil ga konsisten   - Ragi tape/arak dibikin manual dari bahan alam Modern:   - 1870-an: Ragi basah pabrikan mulai dipake   - 1940-an: Ragi kering instan populer pas PD II   - Sekarang: Strain ragi diisolasi & direkayasa di lab buat roti, bir, bioetanol, sampe obat Schwann + Pasteur ngebuktiin ragi itu makhluk hidup, bukan "sihir". Sejak itu manusia bisa ngontrol fermentasi.#kapanfyp #fandex #bismillahfyp
